subject: Post-call: HelioWorks integration recap + prioritized actions
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@helioworks.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@helioworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + suggested next steps (HelioWorks)

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — solid session. Quick recap and a proposed next set of actions so we keep momentum. I pulled notes into the attached Integration Matrix for visibility.

Key pain points you shared:
- Live search relevance drops when partial query prefixes are used (50–60% MRR hit reported).
- High per-request cost for real-time reranking at 200 qps peak (cost sensitivity).
- Need for structured output from assistant to fill their downstream ticketing system (strict schema).

Goals you stated:
1) Improve result relevance for short/partial queries within 6 weeks.
2) Keep incremental cost increase below 30% vs today.
3) Push a constrained structured-output MVP for triage automation by end of Q1.

Product fit summary (redwood scope):
- Embeddings + offline rerank for daily re-ranking candidates to reduce real-time cost.
- Streaming rerank pipeline for high-priority queries (adaptive sampling).
- Structured outputs via function-calling + enforced output schemas; SDK to include structured_output param.
- Small SDK changes required for your client to support streaming partial rerank responses and a structured_outputs hook (see attached redwood_sdk_patch.diff).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Technical kickoff: Ben + Marissa to run a 60m deep-dive (recommended this week).
2) Exchange sample logs & 50 representative queries for prompt/eval (Asha).
3) Redwood to provide cost/latency estimates for two configurations (offline-rerank-heavy vs streaming-rerank-heavy) by 2026-11-24.
4) Procurement intro: loop in procurement@helioworks for SOW/timelines (Asha/Tom).

Attachments: integration_matrix.xlsx, redwood_sdk_patch.diff (patch highlights in email 3).

Thanks — I’ll block a 60m window Thurs/Friday for deep-dive if that works.

—
Michael Grant
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Asha Patel <asha@helioworks.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@helioworks.com>, procurement@helioworks.com
Date: 2026-11-20T17:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested next steps (HelioWorks)

Appreciate the detailed recap, Michael — this matches our internal notes. A few clarifications from our side:
- The relevance drop is most acute on mobile where users type 2–6 chars; average session length is short.
- Our current rerank is synchronous on every keystroke; switching to sampled streaming for top-tier queries is something we want to explore to save cost.
- For structured outputs, our ticketing schema is strict JSON with fields: category, subcategory, urgency_score (0–1), and remediation_steps (array). We can share a schema example.

Next steps from HelioWorks:
- I’ll upload the sample query set and a 2-week log extract to the Drive folder by EOD tomorrow.
- Procurement (cc’d) will review the initial SOW draft; Tom will coordinate timelines.
- We’re available Fri 11/21 for a 60m technical deep-dive at 10:00 PT — does that work for your team?

Thanks,
Asha
Head of Product, HelioWorks
asha@helioworks.com

[Attachment: helioworks_mvp_requirements.pdf]

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@helioworks.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@helioworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T18:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested next steps (HelioWorks)

Thanks Asha — 10:00 PT on Fri works for us. Ben/Marissa, can you join? I’ve included a short technical checklist below so we’re aligned for the deep-dive.

Technical kickoff checklist (what we'd like to cover in the 60m):
- Sample logs & query shapes (Asha) — confirm tokenization patterns and short-query distribution.
- Offline vs streaming rerank tradeoffs: Ben to present benchmarks (latency/cost) for 50–200 qps scenarios.
- SDK changes: Marissa to walk through the small client-side shim needed for structured_outputs and streaming partials (see redwood_sdk_patch.diff).
- Eval plan: quick A/B test design and baseline metrics (MRR, latency P95, cost per 1k requests).

Ben, Marissa — I attached the SDK patch that adds two things: a structured_outputs parameter (strict JSON schema enforcement on server side) and an optional streaming_rerank flag that toggles partial candidate scoring streaming. Patch notes:
- redwood.sdk.Client.call(streaming_rerank=True, structured_outputs=schema)
- Server will enforce schema but return a structured error object if mismatch (so client can fallback to free-text).

Can you review the patch before Fri and flag any major blockers? I expect changes to the HelioWorks client will be minimal (two 10–20 line deltas).

Michael

Attachment: redwood_sdk_patch.diff

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@helioworks.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@helioworks.com>, procurement@helioworks.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + suggested next steps (HelioWorks)

Great call and clear priorities. Quick technical notes and commitments from our side before the Fri deep-dive:

1) Benchmarks & cost scenarios (deliverable 2026-11-24)
- Offline-rerank-heavy: precompute embeddings for candidate pool at night, do lightweight client-side filtering + single-model rerank at query time. Estimated cost impact: +12–20% (tokens + embed storage).
- Streaming-rerank-heavy: partial scoring streamed during keystroke, hybrid model to cap cost at burst windows. Estimated cost impact: +25–30% but lowers latency for high-priority queries.

2) SDK compatibility
- Reviewed redwood_sdk_patch.diff — no major blockers. Marissa will prepare a 10-minute demo of the client shim and the structured_output schema enforcement.
- We’ll add a defensive fallback: if structured_output validation fails, SDK returns {"structured_error": true, "error_details": "schema_mismatch"} so HelioWorks can fallback to the legacy pipeline. (See integration_matrix.xlsx row 4).

3) Data & security
- For logs, please sanitize PII before sharing. We’ll supply an ingestion stub and S3 location for encrypted upload if you prefer.
- SOC2 evidence and security questionnaire answers will be sent to procurement@helioworks.com by next Tue.

Action items (owners):
- Asha: upload sample queries & logs to Drive (due 2026-11-21 EOD).
- Michael: confirm Fri 10:00 PT invite and share meeting agenda (DONE).
- Ben: cost/latency scenarios + slide deck (due 2026-11-24).
- Marissa: SDK demo + patch notes (ready for Fri meeting).

We’ll be ready to map a 6-week pilot timeline after the deep-dive; this will include a small canary on 1–2 services (low-risk) and evaluation metrics.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0178
